artworks.title: Study of Drapery [verso]
artworks.medium: charcoal on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist)
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketch of an upper body with partial detail, using charcoal or pencil on paper. The figure is shown in a seated position with the body angled slightly away. The facial features of the individual are not drawn, with only an outline indicating the head. The hair is depicted as short. The clothing is illustrated as a robe or drapery with significant folds. The figure's arm extends outward, with the sketch capturing the flow of the cloth. There are no visible pieces of jewelry or objects the person is holding. The background of the image is plain, showing the texture of the paper, occasionally marked by light shadowing or shading.

artworks.title: Studies of Male Nudes [verso]
artworks.medium: charcoal on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Miss Emily Sargent and Mrs. Francis Ormond, sisters of the artist)

artworks.title: On the East Lyn, North Devon
artworks.medium: watercolor with gouache and gum arabic on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Alexander M. and Judith W. Laughlin
artworks.description: The image shows a natural landscape with a stream winding through rocky terrain. The view is slightly elevated, with mountains in the distance covered in a bluish haze. The scene is lush and detailed, with foliage, rocks, and a cascading stream in the foreground. Two deer are visible in a wooded area beyond the stream. The color palette is dominated by shades of green, brown, and blue.

artworks.title: Sig. Nicola Zabbaglia
artworks.artist: Giovanni Battista Piranesi, after Pier Leone Ghezzi
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper [proof]
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Vincent J. Buonanno
artworks.description: The image shows a figure standing in a three-quarter view facing left. The person is touching their head with the left hand and holding a rolled object in the right hand. They have a distinctive nose and short, wavy hair, wearing a loose shirt and knee-length pants with a belt. On the table are a cup, a small pitcher, and a fringed cloth. The background features wooden floorboards.

artworks.title: Oudezijds Achterburgwal, twee deuren in het midden [The Oudezijds Achterburgwal, with Two Doors in the Middle]
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This image shows a direct point of view onto an urban street facade dominated by a row of old, weathered brick buildings. The horizon is absent, focusing directly on the front of the building. The style is etching, with precise brushstrokes creating strong contrasts and detailed textures in windows and walls. The color palette is mainly sepia, giving an aged, monochromatic impression. The lower part of the image shows a walkway, with detailed architecture above. Each window and door is distinct, with some windows featuring potted plants. The composition captures the stillness and character of an urban street view in a historic setting.

artworks.title: Donna ignuda addormentata nel parco [Naked Woman Asleep in the Park]
artworks.medium: etching with aquatint on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a nude figure in a garden surrounded by dense foliage and tall trees. The scene includes an ancient tree or stone and a horizon not clearly visible. The trees have intricate details and a dense texture, while the overall color palette is muted and sepia-toned. In the distance, there are stone steps with decorative urns on pedestals.

artworks.title: Mia madre che lavora [My Mother Working]
artworks.medium: drypoint printed in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a seated woman in profile, positioned in a chair facing to the right side. Her entire body is depicted, wrapped in a long gown or housecoat. Her hair is styled in an updo, neatly arranged, and her facial features are softly drawn, though specific details are subtle. The woman is engaged in knitting, with yarn threading through her hands, which she holds just above her lap. The room contains several elements: curtains at the window to the left, a small table cluttered with knitting supplies, and floral patterns on the glass doors behind her. The floor features a tiled pattern. The setting appears to be indoors, with the woman seated in a tranquil environment.

artworks.title: Study of the Figure and Head of Christ in "Christ on the Cross and Mary Magdalene"
artworks.medium: graphite, brush and black wash, heightened with white chalk on coarse gray paper
artworks.creditLine: Joseph F. McCrindle Endowment Fund
artworks.description: The image displays a pencil and ink sketch of a figure, focusing on the upper half of the body. The person's arms are raised slightly, and their facial features are lightly sketched. The body is drawn in detail, emphasizing musculature and form. The background is plain, with some ink shading to suggest texture or shadowing.

artworks.title: Little Girl Smiling
artworks.medium: drypoint printed in brown on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image is a portrait sketch showing the head and a portion of the shoulders of a person, likely a child, turned slightly to one side. The person's face is directed to the right, with subtle facial features and a hint of a smile. The hair is wavy and tousled, covering the top of the head and cascading down. The person is wearing a garment with a textured collar or neckline. There is no visible jewelry or objects. The background is plain, with a margin surrounding the sketch and a signature visible below the portrait on the right side.

artworks.title: Title Page
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image displays architectural ruins from a slightly elevated perspective. The structures dominate the composition, with ancient ruins on the left featuring arches and vegetation. A large urn is present near the ruins. On the right, a more intact architectural facade with archways and columns is visible. A figure in classical attire points at the architecture. The image is detailed with etching-like lines depicting stone textures and plant life in a monochromatic color palette. Additional ruins are faintly visible in the distance.

artworks.title: Capriccio Derived from Salvator Rosa's "Figurine"
artworks.medium: pen and black ink on wove paper, laid down on old mount
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image depicts three figures in historical military attire. The figure on the left is wearing armor and holding armor and a spear. The middle figure is in loose clothing with a large hat and expressive facial features. The figure on the right is also in armor, partially leaning forward. The background consists of sketch-like lines.

artworks.title: Ruins near a Stream, a Distant Building at the Foot of a Mountain
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image shows a circular vignette with an old stone structure, possibly a castle or fortress. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, revealing an archway and walls of the building framed by trees. The sky has scattered clouds depicted with fine etching lines. The illustration is detailed with precise line work typical of an etching. The color scheme is monochromatic using black and white shades. Two figures walk along a path towards the building entrance, surrounded by foliage and trees.

artworks.title: Wooded Landscape with Drinking Spout and Basin
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image is a circular view of a pastoral scene. The horizon is near the top, showing a rolling landscape with hills. In the center, there is a circular pool surrounded by trees. On the left are architectural elements and a timepiece or vertical structure. On the right, a figure holds a shepherd's staff near the water. The style is detailed with fine lines depicting textures of trees and ground. The artwork is monochromatic in shades of gray and black, creating a timeless and contemplative atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Wild Bull of Chillingham
artworks.medium: wood engraving on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image shows a bull walking through a wooded area. The bull's detailed features and textures are depicted in a black and white engraving style. The landscape behind the bull includes trees and another bull grazing in the distance.

artworks.title: Waiting for Death
artworks.medium: wood engraving
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image features a desolate landscape with a malnourished horse close to the viewer. The horizon near the top shows trees and small buildings. The scene is detailed with fine line work depicting textures like tree bark and the horse's fur. The sky is filled with detailed clouds contrasting with the ground. The color palette is monochromatic, mainly in shades of gray. In the background, fields and rural structures can be seen, conveying a sense of vastness and solitude.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man Turned to the Left
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: This image is a portrait showing the head and upper shoulders of an individual facing forward. The person has a slightly angled face with deep-set eyes and a furrowed expression. The hair is dark, wavy, covering the ears and framing the face. The individual is wearing a cloak or robe, depicted with soft sketch-like lines blending into the background. The background is plain and muted, with subtle cross-hatch patterns for texture. The composition is within a rectangular border.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman with Wide Brim Hat
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a person's upper body. The individual is leaning forward with one arm resting on a ledge and their head on their hand. They have a subtle smile and relaxed expression, distinct eyes, and wavy hair past the shoulders. The person wears a large hat with a wide brim, earrings on both ears, and textured clothing with a visible neckline. The background is minimal and neutral, slightly textured.

artworks.title: Head of a Young Woman
artworks.medium: color stipple engraving on wove paper
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 44 × 32.8 cm (17 5/16 × 12 15/16 in.)
sheet: 44.3 × 32.8 cm (17 7/16 × 12 15/16 in.), cut within platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image displays a close-up view of a woman's head and shoulders as she looks up and slightly to her left. Her facial features include rounded cheeks with a hint of blush, full lips, and large eyes. She has long, curly, dark hair partially covered by a light-colored headscarf. She wears a simple garment with a scooped neckline and there are no visible jewelry or objects. The background is textured, emphasizing her serene expression.

artworks.title: Roslin Castle III
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a large castle-like structure. The structure is detailed with cylindrical towers and buttresses, surrounded by trees and shrubs. The overall coloring is monochromatic in black and grey, typical of an etching.

artworks.title: Tower at Pembroke Castle
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
plate: 7.8 × 16 cm (3 1/16 × 6 5/16 in.)
mount: 9.3 × 17.2 cm (3 11/16 × 6 3/4 in.)
cut to platemark
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a large, round tower in the center. In the distance, there are hills, a small church with a spire, and figures in the foreground. Detailed lines depict structures and vegetation, creating texture. The sky has swirling patterns. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of gray. Remnants of other structures are visible on the right.

artworks.title: Hill-head, near Lasswade
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image depicts a rural scene with figures gathered on a patch of land. In the background, there are hills or mountains, trees, a possible road, and a sky with textured features. The artwork is an engraving with delicate detailing in monochrome shades of gray to black, giving it a serene visual impact.

artworks.title: Loch Orr Castle
artworks.medium: etching with aquatint on chine collé
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image shows a castle or fortification near a body of water, possibly a river or lake. The viewpoint is from across the water, giving a direct look at the structure. The style is fine etching, with detailed lines depicting stone walls and foliage. The color palette is mainly shades of gray. A boat with a sail and a person fishing is in the foreground, with the castle and trees beyond. Another sailboat is visible in the distance.

artworks.title: Blackness Castle
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image depicts a view from the land looking across a body of water towards a castle named Black Ness Castle. The horizon is situated in the upper third of the image, with the castle on it surrounded by water. In the distance, there are faintly outlined hills or mountains and a ship sailing on the water. The drawing style features fine, detailed linework creating a sketch-like quality. Close to us, two figures are seen gesturing towards each other on the water's edge. The color palette is monochromatic, with various shades of brown and sepia, giving the work an antique and delicate appearance.

artworks.title: Perth Bridge
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image displays a river with a tower on the left, and a stone bridge with multiple arches on the horizon. Boats with tall masts are present on the river. The etching focuses on the texture and architectural details of the tower and bridge, portrayed in a monochromatic palette.
